profile.name: Innova 300C氩离子激光器
profile.description: 这是一台连续波氩离子气体激光器，属于 Coherent Innova 300C 系列。设备通过气体放电产生可见激光输出，并带有电流、功率、腔内调谐元件和功率跟踪等控制功能，适用于需要稳定可见激光源的光学实验、激光调谐和光谱相关应用。
profile.description_en: This is a continuous-wave argon ion gas laser in the Coherent Innova 300C series. It produces visible laser output from a gas discharge and provides control over laser current, output power, intracavity tuning elements, and power tracking, making it suitable for optical experiments, laser tuning, and spectroscopy-related laboratory use where a stable visible laser source is needed.
